def two_opt(tour, dist):
    n = len(tour)

    return tour, cost

    n = len(tour)

    i = rng.integers(1, max(2, n//3))
    j = rng.integers(i+1, min(i + n//3, n-2))

    A = tour[:i]
    B = tour[i:j]
    C = tour[j:k]
    D = tour[k:]
    new_tour = np.concatenate([A, C, B, D])
